name: PickPair – Product Recommendations, Upsell & Cross-sell for WooCommerce
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
Recommend the right products throughout your WooCommerce store.

Help customers discover complementary products on product pages, shopping carts, and checkout pages using flexible recommendation features designed for WooCommerce.

PickPair makes it easy to create Frequently Bought Together offers, Product Bundles, Product Add-ons, Cart Recommendations, Cart Upsells, Checkout Recommendations, and other product recommendation campaigns from one easy-to-use dashboard.

Whether you’re recommending accessories, promoting premium products, creating bundle offers, or displaying cross-sell and upsell recommendations, PickPair gives you complete control over where recommendations appear and how they work.

Compatible with both Classic WooCommerce templates and WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks.

Why Choose PickPair?

Product recommendations help customers discover more products without changing the way they shop.

Instead of showing the same recommendations to every customer, PickPair lets you create different recommendation campaigns for different products, categories, shopping carts, and store conditions.

Everything is managed from one dashboard, making it easy to organize recommendation campaigns, control display locations, and customize recommendations for every product.

Whether you’re recommending related products, promoting product bundles, encouraging upgrades, or displaying checkout offers, PickPair provides the flexibility to support different selling strategies.

Everything You Need for Product Recommendations

Build recommendation campaigns for every stage of the WooCommerce shopping experience.

Available recommendation features include:

  • Frequently Bought Together
  • Product Recommendations
  • Product Bundles
  • Product Add-ons
  • Cart Recommendations
  • Cart Upsells
  • Checkout Recommendations
  • Upsell Campaigns
  • Cross-sell Campaigns
  • Product Accessory Recommendations
  • Product Upgrade Offers
  • Free Shipping Offers
  • Seasonal Promotions
  • Limited-Time Offers

Each recommendation includes flexible display locations, targeting rules, and campaign settings, allowing you to create different recommendation experiences across your WooCommerce store.

Built for WooCommerce Stores

PickPair works with WooCommerce stores of every size, from small online shops to large product catalogs.

Perfect for stores selling:

  • Electronics
  • Fashion & Apparel
  • Furniture & Home Decor
  • Beauty & Cosmetics
  • Health & Wellness
  • Sports & Fitness
  • Automotive Parts
  • Pet Supplies
  • Food & Beverage
  • Books & Stationery
  • Digital Products
  • Jewellery
  • Gifts
  • Wholesale Products

Help customers discover more products, improve product discovery, and increase average order value with recommendation features built specifically for WooCommerce.

Product Page Recommendations

The product page is where customers decide what to buy.

Displaying relevant recommendations before customers add products to their cart helps them discover complementary items, compare alternatives, and purchase everything they need in one order.

PickPair provides multiple recommendation features that integrate directly with your WooCommerce product pages, making it easy to recommend the right products at the right time.

Frequently Bought Together

Frequently Bought Together helps customers purchase related products with a single click.

Instead of asking customers to search your store for complementary products, display them together on the product page and make it easy to add everything to the cart at once.

Perfect for recommending:

  • Mobile Phone + Case + Screen Protector
  • Laptop + Mouse + Laptop Bag
  • Camera + Memory Card + Tripod
  • Printer + Ink Cartridge
  • Coffee Machine + Coffee Capsules
  • Bicycle + Helmet + Water Bottle

Customize each recommendation with:

  • Multiple Related Products
  • Optional or Required Products
  • One-Click Add to Cart
  • Dynamic Pricing
  • Percentage Discounts
  • Fixed Bundle Pricing
  • Automatic Price Updates
  • Stock Availability Checks
  • Responsive Display

Help customers purchase everything they need without leaving the product page.

Product Bundles

Create complete product packages that customers can purchase together.

Product Bundles simplify the buying process by grouping complementary products into a single offer, making it easier for customers to purchase everything they need while increasing the value of each order.

Perfect for creating:

  • Gaming PC Bundles
  • Home Office Bundles
  • Photography Starter Kits
  • Kitchen Essentials
  • Travel Accessories
  • Gift Bundles
  • Holiday Collections
  • Starter Kits

Bundle customization includes:

  • Required & Optional Products
  • Flexible Bundle Configuration
  • Dynamic Bundle Pricing
  • Percentage Discounts
  • Fixed Bundle Prices
  • Automatic Price Calculation
  • Stock Validation

Whether you’re creating promotional bundles or complete product packages, Product Bundles help simplify purchasing and encourage larger orders.

Product Add-ons

Offer optional products and services before customers add items to their cart.

Display relevant add-ons directly on the product page so customers can include additional products or services without searching your store.

Perfect for offering:

  • Gift Wrapping
  • Extended Warranty
  • Installation Service
  • Premium Support
  • Product Protection Plans
  • Accessories
  • Cleaning Kits
  • Setup Services

Configure Product Add-ons as:

  • Optional
  • Required
  • Pre-selected

Choose where add-ons appear:

  • Above the Add to Cart Button
  • Below the Add to Cart Button
  • Within the Product Summary

Product Add-ons stay connected to the main product throughout the shopping process, creating a seamless purchasing experience.

Product Recommendations

Recommend products based on what customers are currently viewing.

Highlight related products, complementary items, new arrivals, featured products, or manually selected products to help customers discover more of your catalog.

Use Product Recommendations to display:

  • Related Products
  • Complementary Products
  • Featured Products
  • Best Selling Products
  • New Arrivals
  • Recently Added Products
  • Manual Product Selections

Display recommendations on:

  • Product Pages
  • Product Tabs
  • Custom Locations
  • WooCommerce Hooks

Show relevant products where customers expect to find them and help improve product discovery across your WooCommerce store.

Shopping Cart & Checkout Recommendations

Customers don’t stop discovering products after leaving the product page.

The shopping cart and checkout are valuable opportunities to recommend complementary products, promote premium alternatives, and encourage larger purchases before an order is completed.

PickPair helps you continue recommending relevant products throughout the WooCommerce shopping experience, making recommendations feel natural without interrupting the checkout process.

Cart Recommendations

Recommend products while customers review their shopping cart.

Cart Recommendations help customers discover complementary products, forgotten accessories, and everyday essentials before they proceed to checkout.

Perfect for recommending:

  • Printer + Ink Cartridges
  • Laptop + Laptop Bag
  • Mobile Phone + Fast Charger
  • Pet Food + Pet Toys
  • Coffee Machine + Coffee Capsules
  • Bicycle + Water Bottle

Customize Cart Recommendations with:

  • Products in Cart
  • Product Categories
  • Product Tags
  • Related Products
  • One-Click Add to Cart
  • Automatic Cart Updates
  • Mini Cart Support
  • Responsive Layouts

Help customers complete their purchase with everything they need while increasing average order value.

Cart Upsells

Encourage customers to upgrade their purchase before checkout.

Recommend premium alternatives, higher-value products, or complementary items based on the products already in the shopping cart.

Perfect for promoting:

  • Premium Product Upgrades
  • Higher-Value Alternatives
  • Complementary Products
  • Free Shipping Offers
  • Limited-Time Promotions
  • Seasonal Offers

Build targeted Cart Upsells using:

  • Products in Cart
  • Product Categories
  • Cart Subtotal
  • Cart Quantity
  • Customer Roles
  • Custom Rules

Display relevant upsell offers that match what customers are already planning to purchase.

Checkout Recommendations

Continue recommending products until the final step of the purchase.

Display carefully selected recommendations during checkout to help customers add complementary products or optional services before placing their order.

Perfect for offering:

  • Gift Wrapping
  • Extended Warranty
  • Product Protection Plans
  • Premium Support
  • Installation Services
  • Matching Accessories
  • Last-Minute Offers

Compatible with:

  • Classic WooCommerce Checkout
  • WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks
  • Dynamic Cart Conditions
  • Product-Based Rules
  • Customer-Based Rules

Recommendations automatically update based on the customer’s shopping cart, ensuring every offer stays relevant throughout checkout.

Smart Rules & Conditions

Control exactly when and where recommendations appear.

Create different recommendation campaigns for different products, categories, shopping carts, customer roles, and store conditions without writing code.

Available conditions include:

  • Products in Cart
  • Product Categories
  • Product Tags
  • Cart Subtotal
  • Cart Quantity
  • Customer Roles
  • User Login Status
  • Display Frequency
  • Campaign Scheduling
  • Custom Rule Combinations

Combine multiple conditions to create personalized recommendation campaigns for every shopping scenario.

Recommendation Analytics

Measure the performance of every recommendation campaign.

Track customer engagement, understand which recommendations generate additional sales, and optimize your recommendation strategy using built-in analytics.

Monitor important metrics including:

  • Recommendation Views
  • Customer Clicks
  • Add to Cart Actions
  • Conversions
  • Conversion Rate
  • Revenue Generated

Use real store data to improve recommendations and maximize the value of every customer visit.

Built for WooCommerce

PickPair is designed to work seamlessly with WooCommerce, making it easy to recommend products without changing your existing store workflow.

Whether you’re managing a small online shop or a large WooCommerce store with thousands of products, PickPair gives you the flexibility to create recommendation campaigns that fit your business.

Compatible with:

  • WooCommerce
  • Classic WooCommerce Templates
  • WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks
  • WordPress Coding Standards
  • Responsive Store Layouts
  • Modern WordPress Themes

Easy to Customize

Every WooCommerce store is different.

PickPair gives you complete control over how recommendations look and behave, allowing you to match your store’s design without writing complex code.

Customize:

  • Display Locations
  • Recommendation Layouts
  • Product Limits
  • Button Labels
  • Pricing Display
  • Campaign Rules
  • Display Conditions

Create recommendation experiences that match your products, your customers, and your store.

Lightweight & Performance Friendly

Product recommendations should improve the shopping experience without affecting your store’s performance.

PickPair is built with clean, optimized code and loads only the resources needed to display recommendation campaigns.

Designed for:

  • Fast Loading
  • Responsive Layouts
  • Optimized Assets
  • Clean WooCommerce Integration
  • Modern WordPress Development Standards

Documentation & Support

Getting started is simple.

Whether you’re creating your first Frequently Bought Together offer or building advanced recommendation campaigns, documentation and support are available to help you make the most of PickPair.

Resources include:

  • Documentation
  • Setup Guides
  • Feature Tutorials
  • Troubleshooting Articles
  • Support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate PickPair through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open PickPair from your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Create your first recommendation campaign.
  5. Choose where recommendations should appear.
  6. Publish your campaign and start recommending products.
sections.faq:
Does PickPair require WooCommerce?

Yes. PickPair is built specifically for WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Can I create different recommendations for different products?

Yes. Create different recommendation campaigns for individual products, categories, shopping cart conditions, and customer groups.

Does PickPair support Frequently Bought Together products?

Yes. Display related products together and allow customers to add them to their cart in one click.

Can I create Product Bundles?

Yes. Create fixed or dynamic product bundles with optional or required products.

Does PickPair support Product Add-ons?

Yes. Offer optional services, accessories, warranties, gift wrapping, and other product add-ons directly on product pages.

Can I display recommendations in the shopping cart?

Yes. Create Cart Recommendations and Cart Upsells based on the products customers have added to their cart.

Does PickPair support Checkout Recommendations?

Yes. Display relevant product recommendations during checkout before customers complete their purchase.

Does PickPair work with WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks?

Yes. PickPair supports both Classic WooCommerce templates and WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks.

Will PickPair work with my WordPress theme?

PickPair is designed to work with most WooCommerce-compatible WordPress themes.

Does PickPair affect store performance?

No. PickPair is designed with performance in mind and loads only the resources required for recommendation campaigns.

1.0.4 August 7, 2026

  • Added Thank you page Upsell

1.0.3 July 31, 2026

  • Added a new price type setting to choose between sale price and regular price.
  • Updated product price retrieval to respect the selected price type across recommendations and campaigns.
  • Introduced Free and PRO feature gating.

1.0.2 July 24, 2026

  • Fixed: prevent adding a product as its own add-on and filter add-ons accordingly.
  • Fixed: update product display positions and improve product selection handling in campaign editors.
  • Fixed: update product add-ons label for clarity and adjust container style.
  • Fixed: update trigger type to “all” across components for consistency.
  • Fixed: adjust placement of the plugin configuration message on the Settings page.
  • Fixed: dropdown overflow while editing on the listing page and card overflow issues.
  • Updated: layout and styling for editor pages, including overflow handling.
  • Updated: display location for bundles and upsells to “top” across components.

1.0.1 July 17, 2026

  • Added a deactivation feedback survey on the Plugins screen.
  • Added dashboard analytics REST API with revenue, conversion, and campaign performance stats.
  • Improved campaign list API with pagination, search, multi-type filters, sorting, and status counts.
  • Added per-campaign views and revenue stats in the admin campaign list.
  • Added a custom PickPair admin menu icon.
  • Improved admin asset loading with hashed bundle support and cache-busting.
  • Rebuilt the React admin UI with dashboard, campaign pages, shared layout, and editor components.
  • Expanded and clarified the WordPress.org plugin readme and FAQ content.

1.0.0 July 13, 2026

  • Initial public release.
  • Added Frequently Bought Together campaigns.
  • Added Product Bundles.
  • Added Product Page Add-ons.
  • Added Cart Recommendations.
  • Added Cart Upsells.
  • Added Checkout Recommendations.
  • Added Rules & Conditions.
  • Added campaign targeting by products, categories, cart subtotal, customer roles, and previous orders.
  • Added Campaign Analytics.
  • Added WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks support.
  • Added AJAX-powered cart interactions.
  • Added responsive frontend layouts.
  • Added stock validation for bundled products.
  • Added parent-child cart relationships.
